# Nascon Technologies

> Smart Industrial Automation, Custom Control Panels (IEC 61439), and Genuine Automation Component Distribution since 2012.

Nascon Technologies is an Indian industrial automation engineering company and authorized system integrator headquartered in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with a dedicated panel manufacturing and testing plant in Sector-II, Pithampur Industrial Area. Founded in 2012, Nascon designs, manufactures, tests, and commissions turnkey industrial control systems, custom control panels, SCADA/HMI visualization architectures, and IoT remote telemetry for manufacturing plants across India.

- Website: https://nascontechnologies.com

- Manufacturing Facility: 41 Industrial Estate, Sector-II, Pithampur, Dhar, Madhya Pradesh, India

- Standards & Quality: IEC 61439, ISO compliant testing, comprehensive FAT/SAT procedures

## Core Capabilities & Solutions

- [Smart Control Panels](https://nascontechnologies.com/solutions/control-panels): Custom-built PLC Control Panels, Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) Panels, Motor Control Centers (MCC / iMCC), Power Control Centers (PCC), Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC / iPFC), RTU & Telemetry Panels, and bespoke automation enclosures.
- [Automation & Control Solutions](https://nascontechnologies.com/solutions/automation-control): Turnkey PLC, HMI, and SCADA architectures, motion control, drive integration, cloud IoT remote telemetry, and field instrumentation.
- [System Integration & Commissioning](https://nascontechnologies.com/about): Complete electrical engineering design (EPLAN/CAD), wiring, FAT simulation, on-site installation, commissioning, and lifecycle support.

## Product Distribution & Authorized Partners

Nascon Technologies supplies genuine, factory-warranty industrial automation, switchgear, and cabling products from global market leaders:

1. [Phoenix Contact](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/phoenix): Industrial terminal blocks, power supplies (QUINT/TRIO), signal conditioners, interface relays, surge protection, and Ethernet switches.
2. [Multispan](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/multispan): Digital PID temperature controllers, process indicators, digital timers, counters, and panel instrumentation.
3. [Schneider Electric](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/schneider): Modicon PLCs, Altivar VFDs, TeSys contactors, thermal overload relays, Acti9 MCBs, and power meters.
4. [Siemens](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/siemens): SIMATIC S7-1200/S7-1500 PLCs, SIMATIC Comfort/Basic HMIs, SINAMICS variable frequency drives, and SIRIUS switchgear.
5. [Selec](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/selec): Multi-function energy meters, power quality monitors, digital protection relays, timers, and process controllers.
6. [Finolex Cables](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/finolex): Flexible multi-core control cables, copper panel wiring, and industrial power cables.
7. [Gloster Cables](https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/gloster): Heavy-duty LT/HT armoured power cables, instrumentation cables, and fire-survival cables.

### 2. Electrical Control & Protection

- [Surge Protection Devices](https://nascontechnologies.com/products/electrical-control/surge-protection): Type 1+2 and Type 2 lightning and surge arresters.
- [Terminal Blocks](https://nascontechnologies.com/products/electrical-control/terminal-blocks): Push-in and screw-clamp DIN-rail wiring terminals.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What information is required to get a quote for a custom control panel?
To receive a competitive quote, please share your single line diagram (SLD), motor/load list with kW ratings, preferred switchgear/PLC brand (Schneider, Siemens, Phoenix Contact, etc.), I/O count, and environmental requirements (IP rating).

### Where is Nascon's panel manufacturing plant located?
Our manufacturing facility is at 41 Industrial Estate, Sector-II, Pithampur Industrial Area, Madhya Pradesh. Our registered head office is at G-11 Swadesh Bhawan, 2 Press Complex, Indore, MP.

### What are typical lead times for custom control panels?
Standard starter/drive panels ship within 1 to 2 weeks. Complex multi-bay PLC/MCC/PCC panels typically require 3 to 6 weeks, including engineering drawings, fabrication, wiring, and FAT testing.

### Does Nascon Technologies provide on-site commissioning?
Yes. Our field engineering specialists provide complete on-site installation supervision, field wiring termination, PLC/SCADA logic testing, and full plant commissioning.
